place_fields.summary: A major crossroads and well-known landmark in Kaulpet, Bagalkote, on NH367.

planning_attributes.description: Basaveshwar Circle is a major crossroads and landmark in Bagalkote.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located on NH367, Kaulpet, Bagalkote, Karnataka 587101; Basaveshwara Circle Road is also used as a bus-stop location.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The location is described as a busy, noisy crossroads, so take care around traffic.
planning_attributes.notes: Listed as open 24 hours by a local directory; the same location is identified as a FlixBus stop.

place_fields.summary: Aihole is a major archaeological complex of Early Chalukyan monuments along the Malaprabha river valley, representing experimentation and development in Hindu cave and temple architecture.

planning_attributes.description: The Aihole group comprises numerous Hindu, Jain and Buddhist monuments in and around Aihole village; the Archaeological Survey of India maintains the monument sub-circle and museum.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Aihole became a significant centre under the Early Chalukyas from the 6th century CE. Its monuments demonstrate experimentation in temple and cave architecture and include evidence associated with multiple religious traditions.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Aihole is road-connected to nearby places; Karnataka.com reports Bagalkot railway station as about 34 km away. The ASI archaeological museum is within the Durga Temple complex in Aihole.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The monuments are protected archaeological sites under the Archaeological Survey of India; visitor access and preservation rules apply.
planning_attributes.notes: The ASI Archaeological Museum at Aihole is listed as open 09:00–17:00 and closed Friday; this timing is for the museum, not necessarily every monument in the group.
